sort.name: sort
sort.description: Sort by field (use prefix `-` for descending sort)

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Limit the returned documents to a certain number

page.name: page
page.description: Get a specific page of documents

where.name: where
where.description: Constrain returned documents on certain fields (e.g.: `where[date][less_than_equal]=2023-12-24T00:00:00Z`)
